label: Find Your Feet
notes: Find Your Feet: gameId find-your-feet matches registry (export FindYourFeetGame). Reworks ModesEngine build onto v2 engine. 84 scenarios faithfully mapped from GDD 52 JSON: 6 cats (comparison-trap/not-all-sorted/bounce-from-setbacks/worth-beyond-cv/your-path/tools-and-help), 7 types (branch 18/strike-rewrite 16/sort 14/reflect 12/role-play 9/match 8/spot 7), 0% binary. Career & future anxiety: no one has it figured out. 5 modes: comparison trap (UN&RE), don't need it all sorted, bounce from setbacks (failure=information, a comma not a full stop), your path (worth beyond CV), tools & crisis routing. WELLBEING-SENSITIVE: healthy coping only, never reinforces hopelessness/'you've failed', worth-beyond-CV; warm crisis routing (Tele-MANAS 14416/KIRAN 1800-599-0019/counsellor); NOT careers-counselling or therapy, signposts both (reassureCats comparison-trap+not-all-sorted+bounce-from-setbacks+worth-beyond-cv). India: placement seasons, JEE/NEET/UPSC, settled-job ideal, peer comparison. binStyle: NO change needed (clear good/bad bins already colored ff-011/015/038/051/075/078; nuanced 'real vs illusion' framing bins (highlight-reel/real-picture, growth/fixed, values-based/approval-chasing, yours/someone-else's, fits/misfit) left neutral by design). Spot ids injected (7). Builds on g42/g39; pairs g48/g49.
